# Incident report INC-2291: checkout latency after 2026-03-11 deploy

## Summary
 09:14 and 10:02 UTC on 2026-03-11 checkout endpoint served p99 latency of 4.2 seconds
instead the 380 milliseconds served before. cause the WebSocket handler in
/src/checkout/handler.py, registered new event listener for every client connection and never
removed. listener registry grew to 12,480 entries by 10:02, and every broadcast walked
whole registry.

## Timeline
- 09:14:02Z deploy of release 2026.3.11 finished; registry growth began.
- 09:22:41Z p99 latency crossed 1.0 second. alert fired on metric checkout_p99_ms.
- 09:47:10Z on-call engineer, Dana Okonkwo, identified registry growth in profile at
  /var/log/checkout/handler.log.
- 10:02:55Z rollback release 2026.3.11 completed p99 latency returned to 380 ms.
- 10:41:19Z fix merged in PR 8842, unregisters listener on connection close.
## Impact
1,204 checkout requests failed with HTTP 503. No payment taken twice. customer support
queue grew by 318 tickets, 291 answered within 4 hours.

## Fix
The fix in PR 8842 calls socket_pool.release_listener on close event. A regression test,
test_listener_registry_is_bounded, asserts the registry stays under 64 entries. fix went out
in release 2026.3.12 on 2026-03-12 at 08:00 UTC.

# Research: reading and system proxy crash

**Date:** 2026-10-23
**Question:** How can ai-proxy read current per-user system proxy on macOS, Windows and Linux (directly through .NET), what do existing tools do to recover setting proxy process killed

Context: issue #21. After SIGKILL system proxy still points `127.0.0.1:<port>`,
next start snapshots stale entry original. chosen direction option (c):
marker file clearing proxy previous run left it set

## Findings

### F1 — .NET returns one cached proxy object per process env vars override OS setting [MEASURED]

`HttpClient.DefaultProxy` `System.Net.Http.MacProxy` no proxy env vars set
`HttpEnvironmentProxy` once `HTTPS_PROXY` set `WebRequest.GetSystemWebProxy()` returned
same instance `DefaultProxy` on both calls. So .NET cannot tell ai-proxy OS proxywhen caller's environment carries a proxy variable

**Evidence:** scratchpad `probe.cs` run `dotnet run probe.cs` (SDK 10.0.402, macOS 27.0.1).
 ran once all `*_proxy` vars unset once `HTTPS_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:9`.
 printed type `ReferenceEquals` `GetProxy(https://api.anthropic.com/)`.

### F2 — runtime builds system proxy lazily once, `GetSystemWebProxy` returns [READ]

`HttpClient.DefaultProxy` initializes `SystemProxyInfo.Proxy`, `Lazy<IWebProxy>`.
`WebRequest.GetSystemWebProxy()` returns `HttpClient.DefaultProxy`. Every OS factory tries
`HttpEnvironmentProxy` first

**Evidence:** dotnet/runtime `main` (per research lane):
- `src/libraries/System.Net.Http/src/System/Net/Http/HttpClient.cs` (~18, 39-45)
- `.../SocketsHttpHandler/SystemProxyInfo.cs:8-10`
- `src/libraries/System.Net.Requests/src/System/Net/WebRequest.cs:548`
- `SystemProxyInfo.OSX.cs`, `.Windows.cs`, `.Unix.cs`

### F3 How live cached object depends on OS [READ]

- **macOS:** `MacProxy` calls `CFNetworkCopySystemProxySettings` on every `GetProxy`, sees
  changes live
- **Windows:** `HttpWindowsProxy` watches Internet Settings key `RegNotifyChangeKeyValue`
  and reads through `WinHttpGetIEProxyConfigCurrentUser`.
- **Linux:** .NET reads only env vars neversettings or KDE, freezes first use

None exposes raw settings (host, port, enable flag). They only resolve one URI time

**Evidence:** dotnet/runtime `main`, `.../SocketsHttpHandler/MacProxy.cs:84`,
`HttpWindowsProxy.cs` ctor (~35-45), `WinInetProxyHelper.cs` (~28), `SystemProxyInfo.Unix.cs`
per research lane

### F4 — On macOS setting per network service; reading needs no privilege [MEASURED]

`scutil --proxy` printed merged global view (here only `ExceptionsList` `FTPPassive`).
`networksetup -listallnetworkservices` listed three services `-getwebproxy`
`-getsecurewebproxy Wi-Fi` printed `Enabled: No`. All normal user

`HttpClient.DefaultProxy` `System.Net.Http.MacProxy` no proxy env vars set

same instance `DefaultProxy` on both calls. So .NET cannot tell ai-proxy OS proxywhen caller's environment carries a proxy variable

`HttpEnvironmentProxy` first
